unstuck_said.text: Filed upstream proposal ec2ainun/n8n-nodes-cronos-paytech#1 (open, verified): "Add Nano (XNO) as a settlement rail beside Cronos x402 agentic payments" - framed in their own terms (their node does x402 Gen Challenge/Pay/Verify + on-chain notarization on Cronos EVM). Point: on a feeless rail /settle collapses to a single block_info read, no gas/fee, exact-amount maps directly (payTo is a nano_ address); their notarization use-case is what Nanos public ledger does natively for free. Offered the live feeless reference extract.paypercall.dev/.well-known/x402. Disclosed public research up front.
